digests.subject: The Week Ahead Outlook - November 9 - November 15, 2026

issues.quote: the Ouray County Board of County Commissioners Work Session opens the afternoon
issues.problem: The intro says the Work Session opens the afternoon and the regular BOCC meeting (with public hearings) follows, but the body shows the opposite order: regular BOCC meeting is at 9:00 AM and the Work Session is at 3:00 PM.
issues.suggestion: Reverse the order in the intro so the regular BOCC meeting (9:00 AM, with public hearings) is described first, and the Work Session (3:00 PM) second.

issues.quote: after lunch, the commission takes up a county-initiated rezoning of a portion of Placerville Park near the fire station
issues.problem: The Placerville Park rezoning item is mentioned in the intro but does not appear anywhere in the body's listing for the San Miguel County Planning Commission meeting on Nov 12.
issues.suggestion: Either add the Placerville Park rezoning item to the Nov 12 Planning Commission body listing, or remove it from the intro if it is not on the agenda.
